pairs.why: The two are nearly identical; A's gold is slightly brighter and its lighting is softer, closer to the real cards, while B is a bit darker and has more contrast.
Almost the same drawing; A has a slightly lighter, softer finish, and B's darker, higher-contrast metal moves it a little away from the real cards.
B's straw weave is finer and smoother, closer to the soft finish of the real cards, while A's weave is chunkier and more textured.
B has a smoother brim and gentler weave, which reads more like the smooth real cards, while A's coarse straw is too textured.
B's heavy rope-braid weave is much too textured, while A is smoother and closer to the finish of the real cards.
B's brim is smoother at the rim and its overall surface is slightly calmer, though its braided crown keeps the gap small.
A's braided crown and coarse weave are too textured, while B is smoother but not ultra-smooth, matching the real cards.
